implementation_rules: Card focus and hover must remain distinct from activation.
Catalog product identity and local installation identity are different keys.
Product details route must retain productId through asynchronous load/retry and Back.
Context menu actions depend on item category, entitlement and operation state.
Do not invent account, subscription, friends, offer or installation state.
App Settings, app drawers and desktop Game Bar have separate surface ownership.
Linux Nexus/Proton additions must be marked as product additions, not evidence of original layout.
A static symbol is never sufficient to mark behavior runtime-verified.

No console discovery, pairing or streaming capture.
